adjustments.reason: beans at cinnamon brown, Maillard progressing

sensory.aroma_drying: slight bread, maybe hay at 3 minutes; no color change until 4.5 minutes
sensory.observations: color slightly yellow at 4.5 min; full yellow at 6 min; began browning at 7.5 min; cinnamon at 8 min; light brown at 9 min; first crack at 10 min; 7-minute cooling cycle, beans continued developing post-drop; NOTE: 7.9% weight loss is anomalously low given the roast profile — possible measurement error; verify against actual roasted weight before drawing conclusions

acidity.notes: present but not sparkling; less brightness than expected for a washed coffee at this altitude

sweetness.notes: weak caramel and manuka honey; sugars developed but fruit brightness muted

cuppings.tasting_notes_free: Consistent nutty/roasty profile from dry aroma through the cup. Cocoa in aroma didn't carry through as a distinct flavor. Flatness and dry finish suggest abbreviated Maillard phase and possible mild underdevelopment.
cuppings.next_adjustment: Charge at 215°C instead of 205°C to shorten drying phase and allow more proportional Maillard time. Target yellowing at ~5:00 instead of 6:00. Step temps more slowly through browning: 215→220 at yellow, 220→230 at cinnamon, 230→235 at FC onset. Log FC end time to compute actual DTR. Target 2:30–3:00 post-FC end development.
